{{Top|leg}}
A '''vacuum tray''' was a type of ashtray with a receptacle above and a small, mechanical impeller below. The spinning impeller would create a small [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], drawing the residual smoke into the tray and through a filtration system, thus providing a less irritating environment.
